name: How long does a typical shower installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical shower installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a shower installation can vary significantly based on the project's complexity. A straightforward replacement of an existing shower unit might take 1-2 days, while a full bathroom remodel involving new plumbing lines or custom tile work could extend to 3-5 days or more. During the initial consultation, our team can provide a more accurate timeline after assessing your specific project details and the scope of work involved.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard shower installation may take 1-2 days, while complex projects can take 3-5 days or longer. Project complexity and scope are key factors affecting timing.
